name: codex-handoff
description: Protects manual handoffs before context compaction or an exhausted Coding Plan quota window.

interface.longDescription: Codex Handoff preserves project facts in a vendor-neutral Markdown handoff before context compaction or a low five-hour or weekly Coding Plan quota, while leaving the decision to start a fresh session with you.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me prepare or continue a deliberate Codex handoff.
